interface.name: ferrix_appmenu_manager_v1

description.summary: give a toplevel its own menus

interface.description: The menu bar shows the menus of the focused toplevel. A toplevel without menus gets the standard ones.

request.name: get_menu

description.summary: the menus of one of this client's toplevels

request.description: A second get_menu for the same toplevel replaces the first.

interface.name: ferrix_appmenu_v1
interface.description: Menus are built with add_menu, add_item and add_separator, then shown by commit. Each commit replaces the whole tree; an empty commit brings back the standard menus. At most 16 menus and 256 entries; a label is 1 to 128 bytes without control characters. The object dies with its toplevel.

entry.name: bad_tree
entry.summary: an entry came before any menu

entry.name: bad_label
entry.summary: a label is empty, too long or has a control character

arg.name: keys
arg.summary: the shortcut to show, empty for none

description.summary: the user picked an enabled item
